Overflow Layouts

These layouts demonstrate the overflow attribute with column layouts.
The overflow="preview" shows a partial preview of the next item.

Carousel controls — nav

Shared carousel controls from ui/base/carousel.css: dots + arrows via the nav attribute <lay-out overflow nav>

Band below — nav="blw"

Controls in a reserved band below the items — bare arrows <lay-out overflow nav="blw" arrow="bare">

Band above — nav="abv" + arrow="set"

Controls in a band above the items, arrow pair clustered at the inline-end <lay-out overflow nav="abv" arrow="set">

Clustered arrows on media — arrow="set be"

Arrow pair as one cluster in the bottom-end corner, dots bottom-center <lay-out overflow nav arrow="set be">

Dots below, arrows on media — dot="blw"

Dots alone in a band below; arrows stay centered on the items <lay-out overflow nav dot="blw">

Arrows below, dots on media — arrow="blw"

Arrows alone in a band below; dots stay on the items <lay-out overflow nav arrow="blw">

Dots only, pill timer — nav="dot" + dot="pll"

No arrows; the current pill fills over --ui-carousel-autoplay (5s) <lay-out overflow nav="dot" dot="pll">

Arrows only, dark — nav="arw" + arrow="drk"

No dots; dark circles with white chevrons, auto-hidden at the dead end (arrow="hid") <lay-out overflow nav="arw" arrow="drk hid">

Preview + controls — overflow="preview" + nav

Next-item preview composes with controls — arrows advance one item at a time; dots in a band below via dot="blw", full-arrow glyph via arrow="arr". (For a control-less swipe scroller, overflow="stop" gives the same one-item-per-fling stepping.) <lay-out md="columns(2)" overflow="preview" nav dot="blw" arrow="arr">

Pages — pages attribute

Snap + dot per page of N items — dot count adapts per breakpoint (here: 3 dots at 2 columns, 2 dots at 3 columns), dots in a band below via dot="blw" <lay-out md="columns(2)" lg="columns(3)" overflow nav pages dot="blw">

Columns 1

1-column layout (default) <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview">

Columns 2

2-column layout with equal width columns <lay-out md="columns(2)" lg="columns(2)" overflow="preview">

Columns 3

3-column layout with equal width columns <lay-out md="grid(3a)" lg="columns(3)" overflow="preview">

Columns 4

4-column layout with equal width columns <lay-out md="columns(2)" lg="columns(4)" overflow="preview">

Columns 5

5-column layout with equal width columns <lay-out md="grid(5a)" lg="columns(5)" overflow="preview">

Columns 6

6-column layout with equal width columns <lay-out md="columns(3)" lg="columns(6)" overflow="preview">

Preview Sizes

Control the preview width with size modifiers. All examples use columns(1).

Extra Small

40px preview width <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview-xs">

Small

60px preview width <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview-sm">

Medium (default)

100px preview width <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview">

Large

150px preview width <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview-lg">

Extra Large

200px preview width <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview-xl">

Fade Masks

Add fade effects to the overflow edges. Masks animate based on scroll position. All examples use columns(1).

Fade Both

Fade masks on both start and end edges <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview fade">

Fade Start

Fade mask on start edge only <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview fade-start">

Fade End

Fade mask on end edge only <lay-out md="columns(1)" overflow="preview fade-end">
